**What you're trying to do**

**Why Hidra doesn't already cover it**

Hidra is deliberately scoped to keyboard and mouse remapping, no game controllers and no kernel
driver (see the README's "Why Hidra" section). If your request needs either of those, it's likely
out of scope rather than a gap.
